name: Late Sixway p4 lite (submission 57543464, late re-run of 57519900)
rank: per-column percentile rank over the whole scored cohort: pandas.DataFrame.rank(axis=0, method='average', pct=True)

members.S6: Sixway: equal mean of 6 CoAtNet components (sixway_core.csv)
members.C6: H6 ConvNeXt-S, Core6-label arm, SWA of EMA epochs 14-16 (h6_core6_raw.csv)
members.VM: H6 ConvNeXt-S, VM-label arm, SWA of EMA epochs 14-16 (h6_vm_raw.csv)

fallback: a study that H6 could not score (NaN row) takes the Sixway rank in the C6/VM slot
s6_only_columns: columns whose weights are {S6: 1.0} keep the raw Sixway probability (no ranking)
note: Same members as FINAL ens; H6 only on Medial OA, Lateral OA, PF OA and Baker's. Public 0.968 / private 0.959 as a late submission. The 22.10 original (57519900) produced no score: that day's hidden-test run was slower than usual, H6 hit its time budget for more than 3% of studies and our strict failure rule wrote no submission.csv. The late re-run used the rule 'study not reached in time -> Sixway rank' (as predict.py does).
